summary: Iteration 2 — verified ShelfWise's strict premium gate end-to-end. Updated /app/backend/tests/test_medstore.py to reflect new behavior: free users blocked with HTTP 402 on POST /medicines and OCR; admin bypasses gate; alert endpoints (/api/alerts/recent, /api/alerts/live) return per-item details; bank details now expose new UPI QR URL (5riryn4o_IMG_20260428_180302.jpg) + 8919803257@fam + Majid Hussain + upi:// deep link. 18/18 pytest passed in 8.89s. Frontend Playwright (mobile + desktop): fresh-registered free user redirects to /tutorial; 7-step tutorial with indicator/prev/next + skip works; free user blocked from /, /inventory, /add, /upload, /admin (all redirect to /tutorial); /membership shows correct QR image src, UPI ID, deep-link button, payment form; free-user layout hides app nav and shows only Tour button; admin login lands on / with full nav (desktop) + admin link + premium badge; admin can navigate to /inventory, /add, /upload, /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: require_premium() is correctly strict — admin short-circuits via is_admin, premium short-circuits via is_premium_active(); no race conditions remaining since the legacy 10-item count check was removed.
POST /api/admin/payments/{id}/approve correctly extends premium_expires_at by 30 days from max(now, current_exp) — supports stacking renewals.
/api/alerts/recent uses setdefault('items', []) for backwards compat with older alerts written before the schema change — good.
/api/alerts/live filters items in next 10 days but does NOT also include already-expired items; if product wants 'expired + expiring' aggregated, add a second branch.

Membership page: open-upi-btn is a <Button> using window.location to fire the upi:// scheme via onClick — works on mobile but cannot be tested via element href attribute. Consider rendering as a real <a href={bank.upi_deep_link}> (still styled like a button) so it works even if JS fails and the deep-link is visible/copyable for QA.
App.js PublicOnly redirects logged-in users to / or /tutorial based on is_premium — correct, but if a fresh token is stale (premium just granted server-side), user must refresh. Acceptable for MVP.
Free users can still hit /api/payments/submit, /api/dashboard/stats, /api/medicines (read), /api/alerts/* — intentional and verified.
server.py is now ~700 lines; should be split into routers (auth, medicines, payments, admin, ocr, alerts) once it grows further.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@medstore.com / Admin@12345 (seeded, permanent premium). Free users registered dynamically as TEST_*@example.com.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run registers 2 free users (TEST_free_*, TEST_approve_*) and creates a few TEST_-prefixed medicines (cleaned up in finally). Frontend run registers TEST_fe_* / TEST_fe2_* free users (left in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requirements from review_request verified PASS. Backend: 18/18 pytest covering auth, premium gate (free 402 + admin bypass), medicine CRUD as admin, OCR as admin (live LLM call), bank details with new QR/UPI, payment submit+list, admin approve/reject, admin grant/revoke, admin stats, admin guards, /alerts/recent items[], /alerts/live shape. Frontend: register→/tutorial, 7-step Tutorial (testids tutorial-page, tutorial-step-indicator, tutorial-next, tutorial-prev, tutorial-skip, tutorial-step-body, tutorial-logout), Membership (testids membership-page, upi-qr-image, open-upi-btn, copy-upi, pay-ref, pay-note, pay-submit, payment-history), Layout (premium-badge, tour-link, admin-link, logout-btn, nav-{label}-desktop, nav-{label}-mobile, brand-logo). open-upi-btn is a Button (no href); verify via click + window.location, not get_attribute('href'). Admin desktop nav uses *-desktop testids; mobile uses *-mobile bottom bar. Date inputs are still native browser pickers (low-priority polish from iter_1).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs encountered. All review_request acceptance criteria verified pass.
